_doc: Allowlist for qa/runner/run-guard-from-ref.mjs. A regression guard may be executed from a pinned source worktree ONLY if its path is listed here AND the blob SHA of the file at the requested ref is one of its pinned_blob_shas. No heuristic decides safety - not import scanning, not 'looks like a static check'. Adding an entry is a founder-approved review of the exact file content at the exact blob. Unknown path or unpinned blob -> BLOCKED_GUARD_NOT_ALLOWLISTED.
